baselineIntent: This score deliberately supersedes the permissive 100-point grid. It is expected to fail until time-varying timbre, decay, texture, and global level residuals are corrected.

source.audioPolicy: Reference WAV/FLAC files are decoded only by this development tool. Only directly recorded keys are measured; no pitch-shifted audio or features enter the cache.

method.alignment: independent causal 3 ms RMS onset detection; all temporal comparisons are onset-relative
method.gain: one robust global synth/reference offset (-0.0457 dB); no per-note, per-register, or per-layer normalization for level
method.referenceStereo: left/right spectra and RMS energies are power-averaged; waveform phase is not scored
method.attackEnvelope: 4 ms power-RMS windows every 2 ms from 0–120 ms, locally peak-normalized
method.attackTiming: 10%, 50%, and 90% cumulative-energy times in the first 120 ms
method.sustainSpectrum: 7 profiles from 25 ms–2.05 s using 6-cycle windows clamped to 46–180 ms
method.partials: up to 16 local partial peaks; frame-wise balance plus per-partial decay and long-window location stretch
method.decay: broadband, per-auditory-band, and per-partial changes, all normalized once at 80 ms
method.texture: harmonic-to-residual ratio plus detrended fundamental modulation depth/roughness
method.limitations: These are perceptual proxies, not a claim of waveform identity. They intentionally ignore source microphone phase/stereo image, and level permits one global output-gain calibration.

checks.name: every supplied sustain recording is independently analyzed
one global gain aligns loudness over pitch and velocity
checks.proxy: 0.02–0.50 s stereo-power RMS; one median offset only, preserving all cross-note differences.

checks.name: fine-grained 120 ms attack envelope converges
checks.proxy: Sixty 4 ms RMS measurements replace the old five-bin onset summary.

checks.name: attack energy accumulation timing converges
checks.proxy: Differences at 10%, 50%, and 90% of first-120-ms energy.

checks.name: hammer/board spectrum converges through 110 ms
checks.proxy: Five time-localized 14-band spectra; frame energy is normalized but spectral shape is not collapsed to centroid.

checks.name: auditory-band color converges over 2.05 seconds
checks.proxy: Seven adaptive-window spectral profiles expose time-varying color rather than one long FFT.

checks.name: resolved partial balance converges over time
checks.proxy: Up to 16 partials are normalized within each of seven time frames.

checks.name: stiff-string partial locations converge
checks.proxy: Strong partial stretch relative to each measured fundamental; phase and tuning offset are removed.

checks.name: individual partial decay trajectories converge
checks.proxy: Every audible partial is normalized at 80 ms and followed to 2.05 seconds.

checks.name: frequency-dependent decay trajectories converge
checks.proxy: Auditory bands are independently normalized, preventing broadband RMS from hiding wrong spectral decay.

checks.name: harmonic-to-residual balance converges
checks.proxy: Resolved partial energy versus non-partial hammer/body energy in every sustain frame.

checks.name: fundamental beating/modulation converges
checks.proxy: Linear decay is removed from a narrowband 0.12–1.85 s envelope before modulation depth and roughness are compared.

checks.name: velocity curves and every register converge without hidden buckets
checks.target: 10th-percentile level correlation >=0.96, brightness >=0.90, worst critical register p90 <=10
checks.proxy: Cross-layer correlations and register-specific tails prevent favorable global medians from masking scale regions.
